title: Last Step Matters: Early Uncertainty Cannot Predict Failure in Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.29685v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early failure prediction is important for long-horizon agents, as it enables timely intervention and can reduce inference and tool-use costs. Uncertainty quantification, such as verbal confidence and perplexity, offers a promising approach to detecting agent failures; however, it has not been explored whether these signals retain their discriminative power during the intermediate stages of long-horizon execution. We evaluate mainstream uncertainty signals on deep-research tasks and find that verbal confidence reliably distinguishes failures at trajectory completion, achieving a mean AUROC of 0.85, whereas all evaluated signals offer limited predictive value earlier in execution, with none exceeding a mean AUROC of 0.60 at 50% trajectory progress. translated_title: 最后一步至关重要：早期不确定性无法预测长程智能体的失败
translated_abstract: 早期失败预测对长程智能体至关重要，因为它能够实现及时干预，并可降低推理和工具使用成本。不确定性量化方法（如口头置信度和困惑度）为检测智能体失败提供了一种有前景的途径；然而，这些信号在长程执行的中间阶段是否仍保持其判别能力尚未被探索。我们在深度研究任务上评估了主流的不确定性信号，发现口头置信度在轨迹完成时能够可靠地区分失败，平均AUROC达到0.85；而所有被评估的信号在执行早期提供的预测价值有限，在轨迹进度达到50%时，没有任何一个信号的平均AUROC超过0.60。我们识别出解释这一差距的潜在机制：路径切换，即智能体在轨迹执行过程中频繁放弃当前的搜索方向，破坏了早期信号与最终结果之间的联系。
tldr: 该研究发现主流不确定性信号（如口头置信度）仅在长程智能体轨迹完成时才能可靠预测失败（平均AUROC达0.85），而在执行早期预测价值有限（50%进度时AUROC不超过0.60），其根本原因在于智能体在执行过程中频繁进行“路径切换”，切断了早期信号与最终结果的联系。
en_tdlr: This study finds that mainstream uncertainty signals (e.g., verbal confidence) reliably predict agent failures only at trajectory completion (mean AUROC 0.85) but offer limited predictive value early in execution (none exceeding 0.60 at 50% progress), due to a "path switching" mechanism where agents frequently abandon their current search direction, breaking the link between early signals and final outcomes.
